title: Document the read-only reviewer input-identity contract
outcome: docs/features/agent-delegation-sessions.md and docs/features/review-freeze-verification.md describe, and cross-link, the read-only reviewer input-identity contract: per-attempt admission and manifest, the rule that the admitted check is the last before submitting, the stable [identity-*] refusal codes and which are 429, the durable envelope's inputIdentity field, and that an attempt in flight across a host restart fails closed.
acceptance: Both feature briefs describe the admission, check ordering, every [identity-*] refusal code with its HTTP status, the inputIdentity envelope field, the accepted-result slot binding, and the restart fail-closed rule, and they link to each other.
